name: @reddb/code-nav-mcp
description: LSP-backed code navigation as an MCP server: symbol-level goto-definition, find-references, document/workspace symbols and hover for code agents.

scripts.bundle: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --minify --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --outfile=../../../../../dist/code-nav-mcp.bundle.min.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cr } from 'node:module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);"
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run bundle
